extension.news:
v0.2.10 (2026-10-26) - Verify the IPTV Simple setup: read the paths back and fail with a warning when Kodi did not keep them. - Write catchup, EPG cache and logo settings only from the explicit setup. - Keep the other PVR instances untouched instead of copying settings.xml over them. - Do not restart IPTV Simple before the first playlist exists.
v0.2.9 (2026-10-26) - Keep the previous playlist and guide when a provider returns no data. - Record per-provider counts and accept a real decrease after three failed passes. - Retry an incomplete pass after 15 minutes, then 1 hour, then 6 hours.
v0.2.8 (2026-10-26) - Wait for the PVR to stop before restarting IPTV Simple, and postpone the restart during playback. - Keep the service running when a pass fails, and read numeric settings through the typed API. - Decode provider payloads incrementally, bound the socket read, stream raw XMLTV. - Target Kodi 21/22 only.
v0.2.7 (2026-10-25) - Configure IPTV Simple automatically when it has no playlist/EPG yet.
v0.2.6 (2026-10-25) - Wait long enough before restarting IPTV Simple on Kodi 22. - Retry a provider once when it misses the socket timeout. - Replace playlist and EPG atomically.
v0.2.3 (2021-02-04) - Allow to process raw m3u8 or xmltv data. - Add support for #KODIPROP. - Support multiple groups for a channel. - Improvements for Kodi Matrix. - Update translations.
